how_to_use: Copy profile, fill in what you know, leave the rest null. Unknown facts make a rule come back check_with_ehs, never skip. Pass it as usair_plant_triage(profile=...).

fields.hap_status: major (potential to emit >= 10 tpy of one HAP or >= 25 tpy combined), area, or null.
fields.criteria_pte_major: true if potential to emit of any criteria pollutant reaches the title V major-source level (usually 100 tpy).
fields.title_v_permit: true if the site already holds a part 70/71 permit.
fields.uses_control_devices: true if any unit relies on a control device (baghouse, scrubber, SCR, ...) to meet a limit.
fields.ghg_co2e_tpy: Annual GHG emissions, metric tons CO2e.
fields.coal_processed_tpd: Tons of coal processed per day (for NSPS subpart Y).
fields.burns_hazardous_waste: true if any kiln burns RCRA hazardous waste (subpart EEE instead of LLL).
fields.burns_solid_waste: true if any kiln combusts a solid waste under 40 CFR part 241 (CISWI).
fields.units[].type: kiln, clinker_cooler, raw_mill, finish_mill, raw_material_dryer, storage, conveyor_transfer, bagging_loading, open_clinker_pile, crusher, screen, coal_mill, stationary_rice (aliases: engine, generator, emergency_generator, fire_pump), boiler, process_heater.
fields.units[].kiln_type: Kilns: rotary or other (NSPS HH covers rotary lime kilns).
fields.units[].fuel: List: coal, petcoke, natural_gas, diesel, fuel_oil, propane, biomass, tires, ...
fields.units[].construction_date: YYYY-MM-DD (YYYY or YYYY-MM are accepted; a partial date that straddles a threshold stays unknown).
fields.units[].modified_date: Latest NSPS modification or reconstruction, if any.
fields.units[].modified_or_reconstructed: false if you know the unit was never modified or reconstructed; needed before an old unit can be skipped.
fields.units[].follows_subpart_f: Crushers/screens: true if the unit comes after a subpart F facility in the process (NSPS OOO then does not apply).
fields.units[].order_date: Engines: date the owner ordered the engine (when NSPS construction commences).
fields.units[].mmbtu_hr: Boilers: maximum design heat input, MMBtu/hr.
